personality_one_liner: Quiet luxury and editorial elegance; a warm, minimalist space that prioritizes generous negative space, high-contrast typography, and deliberate restraint.

spacing.rule: Generous editorial spacing. Use ample vertical padding between sections to let content breathe. Hairline dividers between list items.

do's: Use subtle glass effect on the sticky top navigation bar (Header) as content scrolls underneath.
Use glass scrim over full-bleed hero imagery to ensure text contrast.
dont's: Do not use glass on standard content cards.
Do not use glass on the Waitlist form.

screens.name: Landing
screens.purpose: One-page scrolling website showcasing the brand, values, curriculum, and waitlist.

states.loading: Subtle fade-in spinner in brand gold.
states.error: Standard clean error message with reload button.

screens.layout: Full-bleed hero with sticky nav. Sections flow vertically with generous spacing: Hero -> Philosophy -> Student Results (horizontal scrolling cards) -> Meet Alysha (split layout or text over image) -> Story Timeline -> Core Values (horizontal carousel 4:5 images) -> Why Different -> 4-Week Intensive (accordion) -> Waitlist Form -> FAQ -> Footer.

screens.name: Admin Dashboard
screens.purpose: Secure area to manage leads, testimonials, and content.

states.empty: Clean illustration with 'No leads yet' and clear typography.

screens.layout: Tabbed or split-pane view depending on breakpoint. Data tables/lists with filter chips. Crisp white cards on soft cream background.

workspace_vision.alt: Aesthetic laptop workspace in warm light

gold_texture.alt: Minimal gold foil texture for core values

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the 3 Editorial Mobile LIGHT personality. Use Cormorant Garamond for all primary headings, letting size create hierarchy rather than heavy weights.
Implement the sticky navigation header with a glassmorphism effect (blur) so content smoothly scrolls underneath.
Borders should be hairline (0.5pt or 1pt max) using the `border` (#D8CCBB) token. Avoid thick cards; prefer layout separation via whitespace and thin dividers.
Waitlist Form: Input fields should have a solid #FFFFFF background, #D8CCBB borders, and #30251C text. Labels above inputs. No floating labels.
Core Values Carousel: Horizontal ScrollView containing 4:5 aspect ratio cards. The cards should use white backgrounds with gold serif text, potentially layered with the gold texture.
Student Results: Use a chip row for filtering (All/Trading/Testimonials/Progress). Ensure the lightbox can be dismissed via swipe-down gesture.
Ensure the hero image has a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to #24211E at the bottom) so the 'WELCOME HOME' text remains highly legible.
Use Feather icons throughout. Icons must be sharp, single-weight, and sized appropriately.
Do not use gradients indiscriminately; rely on solid, flat blocks of the editorial palette (Ivory, Cream, Espresso, Charcoal). Gold is purely an accent.
Ensure 'Vision of Freedom' and 'Meet Alysha' sections balance text content with full-bleed or beautifully boxed imagery.
